entries.source: I can indeed offer some martial training (talent category Technique/Combat-training) for a fee of 50 gold pieces; or the basic usage of bows and slings (Shoot talent) for 8 gold pieces.
entries.target: 我的确可以为你提供战斗训练（格斗/战斗训练系），你需要花费50金币，或者可以学习使用弓和投石索（射击天赋），花费8金币。

entries.source: I do not have time to talk. This ritual is intense, and we are not alone here. Stop them!
entries.target: 我没时间和你说话。这个仪式非常耗神，而且这里不止我们，拦住他们！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Ben lies defeated at your feet*#WHITE#
T...thank you for... *cough*... saving me from the curse.
I did no... not want for this to...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*he coughs one last time and dies, a smile on his face as his curse is gone.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*本倒在你的脚下。*#WHITE#
谢……谢谢你……*咳嗽*……救我摆脱了诅咒。
我不……不想让事情变成……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他最后咳嗽一声，含笑死去，诅咒终于消散。*#WHITE#

entries.source: What just happened?!
entries.target: 刚才发生了什么？！

entries.source: I'm sorry I didn't manage to protect you and as you were about to die you... fired a powerful wave of blight.
entries.target: 抱歉，刚才我没能保护住你，而就在你快要死去的时候……你发射出了一道强大的枯萎能量波。

entries.source: But I have never cast a spell in my life!
entries.target: 但我从来没施过法啊！

entries.source: You are still tainted by that ... foul Demon! The taint is not all gone!
entries.target: 你仍然被那个……可恶的恶魔污染着！污染还没有完全清除！

entries.source: There must be some of that demon's taint still inside you.
entries.target: 你体内一定还残留着那个恶魔的污染。

entries.source: This is terrible! I assure you I had no idea this would happen. You must trust me!
entries.target: 太可怕了！我向你保证，我完全不知道会发生这种事。你一定要相信我！

entries.source: I do. The Ziguranth are not raving zealots, you know. We will look for a way to cure you, as long as you reject the blight.
entries.target: 我相信你。你要知道，伊格兰斯可不是一群丧失理智的狂信徒。只要你拒绝这股枯萎之力，我们就会设法治好你。

entries.source: This is terrible! What is happening to me?!? You must help me!
entries.target: 太可怕了！我这是怎么了？！你一定要帮帮我！

entries.source: I will. We will find a cure for this together.
entries.target: 我会的。我们会一起找到治好你的办法。

entries.source: I'm a very lucky girl, am I not... This is the second time I've had you to save me now.
entries.target: 我真是个幸运的女孩，不是吗……这是你第二次救我了。

entries.source: Over the last weeks you've become very important to me, and I am glad to have you. This is certainly not the place to talk, though, let's go.
entries.target: 这几个星期下来，你对我来说已经非常重要了，有你在身边我很高兴。不过，这里显然不是说话的地方，我们走吧。

entries.source: You're right, let's get out of here.
entries.target: 你说得对，我们离开这里吧。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[go back to Last Hope]
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[回到最后的希望]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two of you spend some time relaxing on the beach.
The air is fresh, the sand shimmers, and the surf roars softly.*#WHITE#

This was such a lovely idea!
I have had a wonderful time with you today.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks longingly into your eyes.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你们两个在沙滩上放松了一阵子。
空气清新，沙滩闪闪发光，
海浪发出轻柔的涛声。*#WHITE#

来海边真是个好主意！
今天和你玩得很开心啊。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*她含情脉脉地凝视着你。*#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[Lean closer and kiss her]#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[你靠了过去，亲吻了她]#WHITE#

entries.source: Just before your lips touch, you sense that something is very wrong.
entries.target: 在你们俩嘴唇相碰之前，你注意到有什么不对劲……

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[Continue...]#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[继续……]#WHITE#

entries.source: Hi, sweety!
entries.target: 嗨，亲爱的！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[kiss her]#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[亲吻她]#WHITE#

entries.source: Are you settling in fine?
entries.target: 你在这里还住得惯吗？

entries.source: I want to open my own little shop in Derth?
entries.target: 我想在德斯镇开店？

entries.source: I want to study magic at Angolwen?
entries.target: 我想去安格利文学魔法？

entries.source: I want to train at Zigur?
entries.target: 我想去伊格训练？

entries.source:
Well let me say that tank is #{bold}#dreadful#{normal}#, but that weird butler says it is the only way.
I do start to feel better too.
However I must say I get bored around here a little.
Do you remember, I once told you %s Maybe we could find a way to get me there during the day and return for my treatment during the night?
entries.target:
好吧，那个再生槽实在是#{bold}#糟透了#{normal}#，不过那个古怪的管家说这是唯一的办法。
我的确开始感觉好些了。
不过，说实话，待在这里有点无聊。
你还记得吗？我以前说过：%s也许我们可以想个办法，让我白天去那里，晚上再回来接受治疗？

entries.source: Oh yes, I think we could arrange that. Shadow, would it be possible to create a portal for her?
entries.target: 当然可以，我相信我们能做到。堡垒之影，能为她制造一个传送门吗？

entries.source:
Yes Master. I will arrange for that right now.
She will be able to come and go unnoticed.
entries.target:
是的，主人。我马上做。
她将能悄然来去，不被人察觉。

entries.source: That is perfect.
entries.target: 很好。

entries.source: Oh this is great, thank you! My own secret lair, my own life.
entries.target: 噢，太棒了！谢谢！属于我自己的秘密巢穴，属于我自己的人生。

entries.source: I only wish your happiness, I am glad to provide.
entries.target: 我只希望你幸福，也很高兴能为你做这些。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Looking all glamorous she comes closer*#WHITE#
Now my sweet one, where were we the last time?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她打扮得光彩照人，向你走近*#WHITE#
亲爱的，我们上次进行到哪儿了？

entries.source: My memory fails me, care to help me remember? #LIGHT_GREEN#[smile playfully at her]
entries.target: 我记不清了，愿意帮我回忆一下吗？#LIGHT_GREEN#[你调皮地冲她微笑]

entries.source:
Well met, @playername@. I was sent with a message from King Tolak of Last Hope.
I followed the trail of bodies that you left - very impressive! We are lucky to have you on our side.
But enough talk; take this message. I must go now.
#LIGHT_GREEN#He gives you a sealed scroll and vanishes into the shadows.#LAST#
entries.target:
幸会，@playername@。我奉最后的希望国王托拉克之命前来送信。
我循着你沿途留下的尸体找到了这里——真令人印象深刻！幸好你站在我们这一边。
闲话少说；收下这封信吧。我必须走了。
#LIGHT_GREEN#他递给你一个密封的卷轴，然后消失在阴影中。#LAST#

entries.source: Thank you for your courage.
entries.target: 感谢你的勇气。

entries.source: The herald gives you %s.
entries.target: 传令官将%s交给了你。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A Halfling woman stands before you, clad in dark steel plate.*#WHITE#
Take the test, and then we can talk.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名半身人女子站在你面前，身穿暗色钢制板甲。*#WHITE#
先接受考验，然后我们再谈。

entries.source: But...
entries.target: 但是……

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A Halfling woman stands before you, clad in dark steel plate.*#WHITE#
I am Protector Myssil. Welcome to Zigur.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名半身人女子站在你面前，身穿暗色钢制板甲。*#WHITE#
我是守护者米歇尔，欢迎来到伊格。

entries.source: I require all the help I can get, not for my sake but for the town of Derth, to the northwest of here.
entries.target: 我需要一切能得到的帮助，不是为了我自己，而是为了西北方的德斯小镇。

entries.source: Protector, I have dispatched the Tempest as you commanded.
entries.target: 守护者，我已经按您的意思将风暴术士杀死了。

entries.source: Farewell, Protector.
entries.target: 再见，守护者。

entries.source:
Yes, we have sensed the blight of the eldritch forces there. I have people working to dispel the cloud, but the real threat is not there.
We know that a Tempest, a powerful Archmage who can control the storms, is responsible for the damage. Those wretched fools from Angolwen will not act. All corrupted!
So you must act, @playername@. I will show you the location of this mage - high in the Daikara mountains.
Erase him.
entries.target:
是的，我们已经感受到那里奥术力量带来的腐化。我已经派人去驱散乌云，但真正的威胁并不在那里。
我们知道，造成这场灾难的是一名风暴术士，一个能操纵风暴的强大元素法师。安格利文那些可悲的蠢货不肯行动。他们全都腐化了！
所以你必须采取行动，@playername@。我会告诉你这名法师的所在——岱卡拉山脉高处。
除掉他。

entries.source: You can count on me, Protector.
entries.target: 交给我吧，守护者。

entries.source:
So I have heard, @playername@. You prove worthy of your training. Go with the blessing of nature, @playername@ of Zigur.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She touches your skin. You can feel nature infusing your very being.*#WHITE#
This shall help you on your travels. Farewell!
entries.target:
我已经听说了，@playername@。你证明了自己无愧于所受的训练。愿自然赐福于你，来自伊格的 @playername@。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她轻触你的肌肤。你感到自然正在浸润你的整个身心。*#WHITE#
这个应该会对你的旅途有所帮助。保重！

entries.source: Thank you, Protector.
entries.target: 感谢你，守护者。

entries.source: #00FF00#You gain the fungus talents school and your Mana Clash is enhanced.
entries.target: #00FF00#你获得了真菌技能树，你的奥术对撞也被强化了。

entries.source:
Thank you, @playername@! We both survived for the wealth of the Empire. I will bring them the news and then rest.
I do not think I want to see death so closely for some time now.
Farewell.
entries.target:
谢谢你，@playername@！为了帝国的财富，我们俩都活下来了。我会把消息带给他们，然后好好休息。
我可不希望和死神再来一次亲密接触了。
再见。

entries.source: For the Empire! Take care.
entries.target: 帝国万岁！多保重。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A ray of light illuminates the gleam of steal amidst the grass. Investigating, you find a lone sun paladin lying stricken on the ground. Her wounds are minor, but her pallid features bely a poison that is taking its final toll. She whispers to you.*#WHITE#
Help, Help me.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一束光照在草丛中，映出钢铁的闪光。你上前查看，发现一名孤身的太阳骑士瘫倒在地。她的伤口并不严重，但苍白的面容表明毒素正夺去她最后的生机。她向你低声恳求。*#WHITE#
救命，请帮帮我。

entries.source: What should I do?
entries.target: 我该怎么做？

entries.source:
I found it... the abomination Aeryn sent me to seek out. The breeding pits of the orcs... It is more vile than you can imagine... They have it hidden away from their encampments, out of sight of all their people. Their mothers, their young, all there - all vulnerable!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She pulls out a sketched map, and with some effort puts it in your palm.*#WHITE#

This could be the final solution, the end to the war... forever. We must strike soon, before reinforcements...

#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks hard at you, exerting all her effort into a final pleading stare.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
我找到了……艾琳派我寻找的那个丑恶之地。兽人育种棚……它比你能想象的还要邪恶……他们将其藏在远离营地的地方，避开了所有族人的视线。他们的母亲和幼儿都在那里——全都毫无防备！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她抽出一张手绘地图，吃力地将它放进你的手心。*#WHITE#

这可能是最终解决方案，让战争终结……永远终结。我们必须尽快动手，赶在援军到来之前……

#LIGHT_GREEN#*她紧盯着你，用尽全部力气，最后一次用目光向你恳求。*#WHITE#

entries.source: I cannot do this myself... I will tell Aeryn about it, it is in her hands.
entries.target: 我无法亲手这么做……我会把这件事告诉艾琳，交给她处置。

entries.source: I will go myself and ensure this is thoroughly dealt with.
entries.target: 我会亲自前往，确保彻底解决此事。

entries.source: You want me to kill mothers and children? This is barbaric, I'll have nothing to do with it!
entries.target: 你让我去杀害母亲和孩子？！这过于残忍了，我绝不接受！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands... you. You seem to be slightly older, and by the look of it you have been through hell.*#WHITE#
NO! YOU CAN'T! NO GOING THERE! YOU... I... YOU MUST NOT GO THERE!
THIS CANNOT BE AVOIDED! I MUST STOP IT! PLEASE DON'T!
I MUST KILL MYSELF TO PROTECT MYSELF!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you can react, you... I... yourself vanishes into a rift hanging in midair.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你面前站着……你自己。这个你看上去年长了一些，仿佛在地狱中走过一遭。*#WHITE#
不！你不能！不能去那儿！你……我……你不许去那儿！
这无法避免！我必须阻止它！请不要这样！
我必须杀死我自己来保护自己！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你来得及做出反应之前，你……我……你自己消失在悬于半空的裂缝中。*#WHITE#

entries.source: What the...
entries.target: 这是什么……

entries.source: Buy a new slot with one #{bold}#talent category point#{normal}#.
entries.target: 花费 1 个#{bold}#技能树解锁点#{normal}#购买一个新刻印位。

entries.source: Cancel
entries.target: 取消

entries.source: You have too many of this type of inscription. You can only override an existing one. The old inscription will be lost.
entries.target: 你拥有的此类刻印过多，只能覆盖一个现有刻印。旧刻印将会消失。

entries.source:
You have reached your maximum number of inscriptions (infusions/runes).
If you have unassigned #{bold}#talent category points#{normal}# you can use one to create a new slot (up to 5).
You can replace an existing one or cancel.
The old inscription will be lost.
entries.target:
你的刻印（注入/符文）数量已经达到上限。
如果你还有未分配的#{bold}#技能树解锁点#{normal}#，可以花费 1 个来创建新刻印位（最多 5 个）。
你可以替换一个现有刻印，也可以取消。
旧刻印将会消失。

entries.source: @playername@, nice to see you again! Or is this the first time that you have seen me?
entries.target: @playername@，很高兴再次见到你！还是说，这是你第一次见我？

entries.source: Farewell, Grand Keeper.
entries.target: 再见，现实至高守护者。

entries.source: Yes, this is our first meeting.
entries.target: 是的，我们是第一次见面。

entries.source:
Ah, for you perhaps, but not for me.
Listen, someday you will encounter me again but it will not be me you see now. It will be younger me, if you will.
This is very important: do not tell my previous me about me. Understood?
entries.target:
啊，对你来说也许是的，不过对我来说可不是。
听着，有一天你会再次遇到我，但你见到的不会是现在的我，而是更年轻的我。
这一点非常重要：不要把我的事告诉过去的我。明白吗？

entries.source: I think so...
entries.target: 我想是吧……

entries.source: Yes, Grand Keeper.
entries.target: 是，现实至高守护者。

entries.source:
@playername@, I am one of a party of Sun Paladins sent by Aeryn. We arrived here tracking the orcs.
They have gone through the portal, and a few of my friends were pulled in with them.
We captured an orc earlier.  He revealed that the staff you seek is to be used to absorb the power of a remote place for dark rituals.
You must traverse this portal, if you have any means to, and stop the orcs.
entries.target:
@playername@，我是艾琳派来的一队太阳骑士中的一员。我们追踪兽人来到了这里。
他们穿过了传送门，我的几个朋友也被卷了进去。
之前我们抓住了一个兽人。他透露，你所寻找的法杖将被用来吸收某个遥远之地的力量，以供黑暗仪式之用。
如果你有办法穿过这道传送门，就必须过去阻止那些兽人。

entries.source: I think I can use the portal. Do not worry!
entries.target: 我想我能够使用这个传送门，别担心！

entries.source: Where?!
entries.target: 在哪里？！

entries.source:
One of our patrols noticed some strange orc movements around the southern part of the continent, in the desert of Erúan.
A group of orcs were guarding something that looked like the staff you asked about.
You should go there to investigate. This might be your only chance.
entries.target:
我们的一支巡逻队在大陆南部的艾露安沙漠发现了一些兽人的异常动向。
一群兽人在守卫着一件东西，看上去好像是你提到的那个法杖。
你应该去调查一下，这可能是你仅有的机会。

entries.source: I will, right now!
entries.target: 我马上就去！
